_doc: Conform & finishing for composite.py. Cut frames come from timing/shots.json (cut_f0 of the incoming shot).
A transition of N frames centred on the cut covers [cut - N//2 + offset, cut - N//2 + offset + N); both shots
must have those frames (6 handle frames each side), composite.py checks and clamps.
Types: cut | dissolve | light (additive bloom-flash crossfade) | colormatch (luma-led dissolve) |
luma (incoming highlights lead) | zoom (scale-up + radial blur zoom-through) | defocus (rack-focus dissolve) |
dip (through near-black). 'flash' scales the light dissolve's exposure bloom.
grade: per-shot trims in scene-linear light, neutral by default: exposure (stops), temp (+ = warmer,
~mired-like units, 10 = subtle), tint (+ = magenta), sat (1 = neutral), contrast (1 = neutral, pivot 0.18).
